title: Data-Aware Model Merging in the Essential Subspace for Multi-Task Knowledge Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2606.19164v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model merging enables training-free multi-task learning by aggregating knowledge from models fine-tuned from a shared checkpoint, but their task updates can interfere. Using proxy data, we find that task updates induce output shifts whose energy concentrates in a few dominant directions, while many low-energy directions can accumulate across tasks and impair performance. We call the span of the dominant directions the essential subspace. This observation motivates a data-aware framework to preserve essential task knowledge while reducing interference. Essential Subspace Decomposition (ESD) identifies each task's essential subspace from activation shifts measured on proxy data and represents its update compactly while preserving functional behavior. translated_title: 面向多任务知识聚合的本质子空间中数据感知模型合并
translated_abstract: 模型合并通过聚合从共享检查点微调而来的多个模型的知识，实现无需训练的多任务学习，但各任务的更新之间可能产生干扰。利用代理数据，我们发现任务更新所引起的输出偏移，其能量集中在少数主导方向上，而许多低能量方向会在任务之间不断累积并损害性能。我们将这些主导方向张成的空间称为本质子空间。这一观察启发我们提出了一个数据感知框架，在保留关键任务知识的同时减少干扰。本质子空间分解（ESD）从在代理数据上测得的激活偏移中识别每个任务的本质子空间，并在保持功能行为的同时对其更新进行紧凑表示。本质子空间合并（ESM）根据每个任务更新方向所对应的输出偏移特征值对其进行加权，从而优先考虑核心任务知识；随后对（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种数据感知的模型合并框架，通过本质子空间分解（ESD）与本质子空间合并（ESM），在保留各任务核心知识的同时有效减少任务更新间的干扰，实现无需训练的多任务知识聚合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-aware model merging framework that uses Essential Subspace Decomposition (ESD) and Essential Subspace Merging (ESM) to preserve core task knowledge while reducing interference between task updates, enabling training-free multi-task knowledge aggregation.
